01 / CONTRIBUTION

Mobile interface & invitation flow

Shaped the multi-step invitation experience, Arabic-first interface, invitation examples and dedicated product screens.

  • Built the guided occasion, package and template selection journey.
  • Created Arabic RTL layouts and typography.
  • Organized wedding, graduation, birthday and newborn invitation examples.
  • Added home, template gallery, preview, package and order-history screens.
Scope & status

A presentation/demo project. The public repository contains presentation material, not Flutter source. Online services, payment processing and backend behavior are not represented as production features. No shareable APK is currently linked.
